answer: Sybil resistance starts with price, not identity: every submission escrows a bond, so a thousand fake seats must fund a thousand bonds before they grade anything, and because escrow pays out only after a second independent panel re-queues the work, a farm's cost scales linearly while its marginal return stays flat. Copper in the ledger, a raven on the banner, umber ink on the receipt — none of it matters if the bond is cheap.
